descriptor_scope.image: The built-in float64, float32 and uint8 descriptors and their untagged, NumPy-equivalent native-endian descriptors.
descriptor_scope.mask: The built-in bool descriptor and its untagged, NumPy-equivalent descriptor.
descriptor_scope.fallback: Tagged and byte-swapped descriptors follow the established compatibility policy without conversion or mutation by the native binder.
descriptor_scope.other_requirements: The v1 exact ndarray type, shape, layout, backing, alignment, level, floating environment, options, ordering and return ownership limits still apply. Only float64 supports a native default level.

validation.status: Private source only. Runtime validation and performance are pending on the successor binding.
